id.definition: source numeric product ID namespaced by supplier

sourceProductId.definition: Exact external numeric ID; never name-matched

sku.definition: Source code; not global asset ID

sourcePageSHA256.definition: Hash of stored HTML snapshot, anonymous CSRF values removed

imageURLs.definition: URLs only; empty if source has none

brand.definition: Null when explicit source brand field is empty; retailer not assumed manufacturer

category.definition: Local navigation classification, source category retained separately

specificationNotes.definition: Selected factual bullets; may apply to variant family, never physical condition

offerSnapshot.definition: New retail amount/currency/observedAt/source; not owner valuation

unknownPolicy: Unknown remains null or empty array; no fabricated brand, photo or measurements
identityPolicy: No allocation in sole AST registry; LOCAL UUID only when user selects a catalog entry
modelVsItem: a:ProductModel in shared dataset; owned user item optionally a:model references it. Wishlist/reference use LibrarySelection, not ToolPassport.
